purpose: Independent source-rule generation versus the existing TCSVT21 finite-channel model
source_locators: printed pp. 2900-2901, Theorem 1 proof and coefficient discussion
implementation_status: Independent reconstruction of declared source semantics, not source-author software
proposal_assumption: Independent uniform coefficient proposals on each declared domain; the source does not fully specify this probability law
permutation_assumption: Independent uniform permutation of the three hidden RG bits at each pixel
rng: numpy.random.PCG64 with SeedSequence([base_seed, stage, domain_index, bit_or_trial, optional_chunk_start])
goodness_of_fit: Pearson chi-square on positive expected cells, Holm correction across all participant rows and hidden-pattern rows
negative_control: Deliberately resample hidden pattern upon coefficient rejection; not the audited source execution
preprocessing: Pillow L grayscale, largest centered square, LANCZOS resize to 64x64; lexicographic filenames
authentication_mask: Strictly above reference-image median is one; otherwise zero
schedule_source: Existing data/repeated_shadow_summary_p{participant}_b12.json, greedy_positions per domain; no reselection
observation_path: Full image generation, lossless PNG encode/decode of both shares, selected-coordinate extraction, MAP with enumerated channel likelihoods
ground_truth: Identity of the real BSDS500 input image used to generate the shadow
comparison: Independent-run difference of mean top-1 fractions; normal 95% CI using both trial-level variances
equivalence_rule: Require the whole two-sided 95% CI for source minus channel accuracy to lie within +/-0.5 percentage points for each stratum and the equal-stratum aggregate
aggregate: Average four participant-domain accuracies within each source trial, preserving correlation of the two shares generated together
failure_handling: Any support, reconstruction, acceptance, or PNG round-trip mismatch is a validation failure; report corrected GOF rejections and failed equivalence without adding trials or changing the margin
scope: Declared (2,2), F_257, source-compatible image generator; not original-author implementation, larger thresholds, JPEG pipeline, or open-world recognition
_publication_note: Local paths redacted; hashes refer to the original execution files.
